episodes.instruction: Pick up the wireless mouse with left and right buttons and set it on the Cyan mat.
Grab the hand-sized black-gray mouse and set it on Green mat.
Pick up the wireless mouse with left and right buttons and set it on the Red mat.
Use the right arm to pick up the flat-bottomed mouse and drop it on Green mat.
Use the left arm to pick up the mouse with scroll wheel and drop it on Cyan mat.
Pick up the small rounded plastic mouse with the right arm and drop it onto the Yellow mat.
